en.askTitle: Enter your own pay, partner’s income and dividends and get the same before-and-after tax check for Brazil’s 2026 change
en.runTitle: São Paulo: a couple and Brazil’s new income-tax rules, from monthly withholding to the 2027 return

fields.label: Your gross monthly pay
fields.value: BRL 6,800, plus 13th salary and vacation bonus

fields.label: Health and school costs, itemised by beneficiary
fields.placeholder: e.g. child’s school BRL 1,800 a month, partner’s health plan BRL 900 a month

en.template: Help me work out what Brazil's 2026 income-tax change does to my household. I am {me} in {city}, my partner is {partner}, and we have {children} children. My gross monthly pay is {pay}, my partner's pró-labore is {prolabore} and the dividends are {dividends} a month from a {company}. Recompute our monthly withholding before and after the reduction, the 2027 refund or amount to pay for separate and joint returns using our real health and school costs of {costs}, and check whether any single dividend payment could pass the monthly line. List what I should do before 31 December and what I should ask my accountant, and mark everything that is not confirmed. Ask before contacting anyone or paying anything.

phases.title: Read the law text, the Receita Federal Q&A and the 2026 tables, then write and check the guide
phases.note: Withholding before and after the reduction, dividend rules and a joint-or-separate return comparison
phases.judgment: It did not lean on a court case it could not confirm: one colleague’s reading of the case conflicted with another’s, who found no trace of that case number, so the guide treats it as unconfirmed news. Open points such as the pró-labore contribution and the 2027 filing dates stay marked unconfirmed.
